item.description: Although he’ll remain with Ohio State for the duration of its College Football Playoff run, Brian Hartline was officially introduced as South Florida’s new head coach on Monday. item.title: Ohio State Quarterback Julian Sayin Named Finalist for 2025 Heisman Trophy
item.description: For the fifth time in eight years, Ohio State’s starting quarterback is a Heisman Trophy finalist. Julian Sayin is one of four finalists for the 2025 Heisman Trophy along with Indiana quarterback Fernando Mendoza, Notre Dame running back Jeremiyah Love and Vanderbilt quarterback Diego Pavia. item.description: Welcome to the Skull Session. item.description: For the first time all season, the majority of stocks are down for Ohio State. item.description: The two most-watched games in college football this season have included Ohio State.
